title: A Halting Length and Output Probabilities
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register machine with oracle, input, guard $G$, and starting configuration $a$. If $a$ has probabilistic semantics with probability $p$, then there is a natural number $N$ such that every sequence of $N$ choice bits makes the run from $a$ halt, every live configuration along each such run satisfies $G$, and the probabilities of returning true and false are respectively $p$ and $1-p$.
hypotheses_covered: The starting configuration has probabilistic semantics with probability $p$
